answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the pulse of free entry disappears, the grove of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the delta case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
